rest_facing: Both GLBs face +Z at rest (glTF forward). Rusana's root/origin stays at her feet; all strike motion is in-place (no root drift at end of clip).

placement.note: Same placement for both strikes, so the fight can start either one without repositioning. Put Rusana at her fight spot; put the guy DISTANCE meters in front of her along her facing, turned 180 deg to face her. Both roots on the floor (y=0), no lateral offset.
placement.general: guy.position = rus.position + forward(rus.rotation.y) * 0.74; guy.rotation.y = rus.rotation.y + Math.PI

guy_sync: The contact was fit against the guy's 'idle' pose at t=0 before the hit and 'flinch' started exactly on the contact frame. Recommended: when a strike starts, crossfade guy to 'idle' reset to t=0 (<=0.15 s fade); at contact_time play 'flinch' from t=0 with a very short fade (<=0.05 s), then chain double_over/knees/floor/tap per scoring. Hit-stop: freeze both mixers ~0.1 s right at contact_time.

kick_up.contact_point_m: instep/shin meets groin at ~0.80 m height, centered between his thighs

knee.contact_point_m: right kneecap into groin at ~0.84-0.86 m height; her hands clinch his shoulders
knee.note: Frame 0 is already stepped into the clinch (she steps forward ~0.2 m in pose, root stays put), so a 0.12 s crossfade from rus_idle is recommended.

walk.note: Scale mixer timeScale = moveSpeed / 0.78 for other speeds.

hurt: loop, extra: hunched pain idle after double_over

morph_targets.note: Expression weights are keyed inside every clip (weights channel on the *_body node), so AnimationMixer drives faces automatically.

loading: Meshopt-compressed + WebP textures: GLTFLoader needs loader.setMeshoptDecoder(MeshoptDecoder) (three/examples/jsm/libs/meshopt_decoder.module.js).
outfit_masking: Body mesh carries a custom vertex attribute _ZONE (three.js: geometry.attributes._zone, RGBA zone codes; NOT used as vertex color) (see out/*_masks.json) for hiding skin under clothes if outfits are swapped.
playback: Clips marked 'once' must be played with action.setLoop(THREE.LoopOnce) + clampWhenFinished=true (double_over / knees / tap hold their last pose). Loop clips: rus_idle, rus_walk, idle, floor, hurt. Each clip's glTF extras also carry {loop, fps, frames, duration}.
